usage: impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --grid            write .impeccable/build/comp-grid.png (10x10 labeled grid) + palette + bands
       impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --regions <json>  measure regions -> .impeccable/build/spec.json
         regions json: { "regions": [ { "id": "art", "kind": "plate|image|texture|text|control|chrome", "grid": "E0:J4", "note": "..." } ] }
       impeccable comp-spec --comp <png> --auto            band regions when you have no regions file
       impeccable comp-spec --print                        the compact spec
       impeccable comp-spec --crop <id> [--out f] [--scale n]   reference crop of a region (never a shipping asset)
       impeccable comp-spec --plate-prompt <id> [--background transparent|opaque|auto]  the regeneration prompt for a raster region
